name: Fallen Sky Lake
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak.  I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost.  I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.

We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.

Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them.  Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.

And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve a Fallen Moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, adventurer, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!

I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, adventurer? If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone. Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
